text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory, head of the Disciplinary
Committee at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting!
A fiery showdown with rivals!
Passionate friendships forged on the track!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!
Let's all dash toward the sunset!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
